# dxf-agent-workbench — LLM Context Map

## Quick Links
- **Entry point**: `dxf_agent.export.orthographic:main` in `src/dxf_agent/export/orthographic.py`
- **DXF export helpers**: `src/dxf_agent/export/ortho_dxf.py`
- **Agent rules**: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
- **Architecture**: [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)

## Core Modules
| Module | Purpose | Location |
|--------|---------|----------|
| orthographic | CLI entry point, rendering pipeline | `src/dxf_agent/export/orthographic.py` |
| ortho_dxf | DXF wireframe & outline export | `src/dxf_agent/export/ortho_dxf.py` |

## Key Commands
- Install: `pip install -e .`
- Run: `dxf-ortho input.dxf --size 3200 --out ./output`
- Test import: `python -c "from dxf_agent.export.orthographic import main; print('OK')"`
